court: High Court of Judicature at Madras
trial_court: Sub Court at Attur, Salem District (HMOP No.147 of 2021)
facts_of_case: Marriage between the parties was solemnised in 2015. Due to misunderstanding, they are living separately. A female child was born from and out of the wedlock. The petitioner-wife is unemployed and cannot travel for contesting the divorce case filed by the respondent-husband.

legal_principles.principle: The domicile or citizenship of the opposite party is immaterial in a case like this.
legal_principles.held: In case the marriage was solemnized under Hindu Law marital relationship is governed by the provisions of the Hindu Marriage Act. Therefore, Section 19 has to be given a purposeful interpretation.

legal_principles.principle: The residence of the wife determines the question of jurisdiction.
legal_principles.held: It is the residence of the wife, which determines the question of jurisdiction, in case the proceeding was initiated at the instance of the wife.

legal_principles.principle: The objects and reasons which prompted the parliament to incorporate a provision have also to be taken note of.
legal_principles.held: While considering a provision like Section 19 (iii-a) of the Hindu Marriage Act, the objects and reasons which prompted the parliament to incorporate such a provision has also to be taken note of.

outcome.final_order: Transfer Civil Miscellaneous Petition is allowed to withdraw HMOP No.147 of 2021 pending on the file of the Sub Court at Attur, Salem District and transfer the same to the file of the Sub Court at Rasipuram, Namakkal District.

use_for_drafting: Guidance on transfer of cases between courts
